text.tspan: Pod A on node 1 → pod B on node 2
4 rules: every pod has its own IP · pod → pod without NAT · node agents reach local pods · a pod sees the IP others use.
A CNI plugin makes them true. Pod → internet: the node SNATs to its own IP → NAT Gateway.
Pod → Service: kube-proxy's DNAT rules on the sending node.
